findings.text: With --max-seconds 0 the monitor ends only on SIGTERM/SIGINT or 401; it ignores stdin/stdout close and the Claude pid (heartbeat alive() at 150-160 only skips beats). If Claude Code dies unsignalled, the orphan lives forever and a new session starts a second monitor on the same state file. Repro: spawn monitor.mjs --max-seconds 0, close stdin, destroy stdout: still running 6 s later. Fix: finish(0) when the Claude pid dies (poll) and on stdout EPIPE/stdin end; add a test.

Comment cites T-MG-23 (the cancelled task) instead of T-MG-35. The assertion is real (regex /--max-seconds 0(\s|$)/ fails on 1740; RED shown in report) but only checks the manifest string, not that the script exits on a closed session.

README says Claude Code sets no deadline and does not restart plugin monitors; this is from docs per the report, not verified here. After F1 is fixed, state how the monitor ends when the session is gone.
